title: Review team config
description: Schema for a repository's docs/conventions/review.yaml: the team layer of the review plugin's settings. Each key here wins over the plugin's userConfig option of the same name. Resolution and layer order: plugins/review/reference/config.md. Contract: docs/adr/0064-home-plugin-customization-in-docs-conventions-yaml.md.

written_against.description: The plugin version the setup writer last wrote this file against, as <plugin>@<version>. The writer owns it; it is not a setting.

provenance.description: Per setting, whether the team chose the value or it was filled at the plugin default. The writer owns it; it is not a setting.

downstream_probe.description: Policy floor. run: /review:quality-gate downstream mode writes one probe for its single safety fact in a temporary directory outside the tree and runs it. report: it states the probe and does not run it. report in this file or in the user's option wins over run in the other. Read from the default branch's committed copy, so a pull request cannot change it for its own review.

fanout_diversity.description: How /review:fanout run-everything spreads its leaf reviews. lens: one reviewer agent per concern (security, architecture, code, docs, each project criteria slice). model: the same review prompt sent once to each distinct fan-out model tier the role map resolves. codex: the lens roster, with the Codex reviewer as the model-diversity panel in place of the model tiers. Skipped for a change set that edits this file.

fanout_act_on_cap.description: How many rows under each ## By axis heading of a /review:fanout report are marked act on: the first this many under ### Spec, and separately the first this many under ### Standards, in merged-rank order. The rest are marked no and stay in the report. Skipped for a change set that edits this file.

smell_baseline.description: Which design-smell list the code-reviewer agent checks. default: the shipped baseline in the plugin's reference/design-smells.md. off: no smell check. A repository-relative path to a .md file: the repository's own list; a missing file falls back to the shipped baseline. Skipped for a change set that edits this file.

council_lanes.description: The council's lane switch. on: an unattended run (a lane, claude -p, an autonomous loop) may start /review:council in this repository. off: an unattended run stops with success and says the switch is off. An attended run never reads it. Repository only: no user option sets it.

council_max_rounds.description: How many review rounds /review:council runs at most. Above 1, /review:fanout fix runs between rounds and each later round reviews only what that fix changed; the loop stops earlier on a round with no new or unresolved CRITICAL or IMPORTANT finding.

council_scores.description: on: the /review:council report carries a mark table by member and round. Marks never rank, gate or stop anything.

council_members.description: The council's member catalog, keyed by member id. Each member names a provider (claude, codex) and optionally a model (an alias, <provider>/flagship, or a provider model id), a shipped brief (correctness, design, adversarial) and an effort. Unset: three claude members on opus, briefed correctness, design and adversarial. A member its provider's adapter cannot run as written is skipped with the reason, never replaced.

council_panel.description: The member ids /review:council runs when no council_rules entry matches the change. Unset: every member in council_members.

council_rules.description: Selection rules /review:council tries in order; the first whose every term matches the change decides the members. paths: any changed path matches any glob. size: fanout's size tier, promotion included. risk: the highest merge-risk level on the reviewed head is at or above this one.
